body_blocks.text:
Hi Matthew,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, here is the revised quote for the mezzanine at the Zoë & Co. unit in Wolverhampton (Café Rouge Lane).

Summary of pricing:
  - Supply and fabricate steelwork: £14,250.00
  - Delivery to site (Lichfield): £1,180.50
  - Shims and packers: £316.25
  Total excl. VAT: £15,746.75

Please note the following “smart quotes” and an ‘apostrophe’ are used here, together with a tab:	done. Temperature rating 20°C, tolerance ± 2mm, 3 × M20 bolts, ½ inch packers.

Drawings are at https://example.com/portal/projects/2026/phantom-peak/drawings?rev=C&issue=2 and the data sheet is here <https://example.com/files/data-sheet-DM-260805-10296.pdf>.

Please confirm that the site team can accept delivery from 7am, that the access route is clear of parked vehicles, and that a forklift with a minimum 3 tonne capacity is available.
